C9000292.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 292 (Kirchberg's $`\mathcal O_2`$ norm-ultrapower embedding problem.; papers: An explicit obstruction to nuclear norm-ultrapower embeddings; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/292.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C292_MAIN.statement: For G = Z[1/2]^3 semidirect (SL_3(Z) x Z), C*(G) admits no unital embedding into B^omega for any nonzero unital nuclear B and free omega on N.

C292_GROUP.statement: The affine property-(T) base group has the index-eight dyadic self-embedding and a finite-dimensional irreducible type inequivalent to every positive pullback.

C292_SPECTRAL.statement: The Kazhdan gap places the representation Laplacian spectrum in {0} union [kappa,4|S|] and detects irreducible occurrence with the conjugate tensor factor.

C292_SQRT.statement: For positive Hilbert-Schmidt X,Y on any Hilbert space, ||X-Y||_2^2 <= ||X^2-Y^2||_1.

C292_WEAK.statement: If sigma has no nonzero finite-dimensional subrepresentation, then L((U_s tensor sigma(s))_s) >= kappa^2/(4|S|) for arbitrary first-factor unitaries U_s.

C292_CORONA.statement: For pairwise inequivalent finite-dimensional irreducibles pi_j, every unital Hilbert-space representation of q(g)=[bar pi_j(g)] in the norm matrix corona has no finite-dimensional subrepresentation.

C292_TRANSFER.statement: For nonzero unital nuclear B, the commuting constant-B and corona maps induce a unital star-homomorphism B tensor_min Q -> product_j(B tensor M_j)/c0.

C292_ESCAPE.statement: For every nonzero unital nuclear B, arbitrary unitary S-tuple u, and pairwise inequivalent nonzero finite-dimensional irreducibles pi_j of a group with the stated Kazhdan gap, liminf_j d(u,pi_j) >= kappa^2/(4|S|), without dimension bounds or separability assumptions.

C292_FINITE.statement: For every fixed arbitrary unitary tuple in a nonzero unital nuclear algebra and a < kappa^2/(4|S|), only finitely many finite-dimensional irreducible representation types satisfy d(u,pi) < a.

C292_VARYING.statement: For every varying-dimensional sequence pi_n in the ultrapower setup, lim_omega d(x_n,pi_n) lies in {0} union [kappa,4|S|].

C292_INITIAL.statement: A putative faithful ultrapower embedding makes lim_omega d(x_n,pi_*) = 0.

C292_PREDECESSOR.statement: On one ultrafilter-large set, every pi in D_n has a predecessor pi' in D_n with pi occurring in pi' composed with theta.

C292_CYCLE.statement: For any homomorphism theta and finite predecessor-closed set D of irreducible types, each pi in D is equivalent to pi composed with a positive power of theta.
